para: a letter, report, record, what a text actually said
ficha: Aged paper lands on a desk with a clipped photo; on the hit the camera pushes in and a marker sweeps over the spoken words.

para: secret file, hidden case, what was inside, revealed record
ficha: Closed folder on a desk; on the hit its cover swings open and a photo gets stapled inside, with the spoken words typed on the flap.

para: spoken years or dates, then and now, how time passed
ficha: Camera travels a corridor of standing photos on a rail and brakes at each spoken date, whose plate slams on. Only for 2-5 said dates.

para: naming one person, who someone was
ficha: Photo of ONE person: camera pushes in, the background goes dark, light falls on them and their index card flies in.

para: connecting clues, everything points to one thing, investigation
ficha: Photos pinned one by one and joined by thread on corkboard; on the hit the camera pulls back and every thread runs to one note.

para: a date, a verdict, it became official, sealed, closed
ficha: Wheels of a rubber stamp spin to spell the spoken word; on the hit it slams on the paper and lifts, leaving the ink.

para: two options weighed, one outweighs the other, trade-off
ficha: Two photos on the pans of a brass scale that hesitates; on the hit one side drops and the other photo goes dark.

para: news broke, it made headlines, the world found out
ficha: A newspaper spins in from the depth and slams flat on the hit: the spoken words are the headline, the photo is printed on it.
